summary: Ridgetech Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company (formerly China Jo-Jo Drugstores), filed a Form 6-K furnishing its proxy statement and notice for an annual general meeting scheduled for August 25, 2026. The agenda includes re-electing four directors, ratifying YCM CPA as auditor, adopting the Sixth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles (creating Series A Preferred Shares and lowering quorum to 33-1/3% voting power), and a capital reduction proposal requiring solvency statement compliance. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender, spin-off, activism) is involved. This is a routine meeting notice; the interim CEO/CFO role is not an event. What to watch: potential dilution or structural change from preferred shares and share capital reduction, but no immediate event-driven angle.
